checks.check: Separately supplied published manifest digest is mandatory and checked before data import.
Only the exact fixed original renderer source hash can be executed; its __main__ is not invoked.
No load_closed call exists; no raw closure/review/trial path is required.
Bounded regular input files reject leaf symlinks; duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite constants are rejected.
Exact original manifest field/artifact domains and data digest are checked.
One task/seed57/two slots and shared-feedback scope are fixed.
Original renderer validate_rows recomputes all row aggregates and utility gate.
Unknown and missing totals, capture versus actual exposure, and unsuccessful outcomes retain original semantics.
Only public relative historical source names and metadata hash labels are preserved.
New output directory is required and original input bytes are rechecked unchanged after rendering.
Redraw manifest distinguishes original hashes, newly rendered artifact hashes and lack of general PNG/PDF byte-identity guarantee.
README and flags explicitly deny fresh closure/audit certification or independent authenticity of a caller-supplied digest.

method: Source/AST inspection only; neither loader nor renderer nor synthetic tests executed.
limitations: The user must obtain the expected original manifest digest from the publication; arbitrary self-consistent data and its own digest do not authenticate scientific claims.
Historical source and closure bindings are retained, not independently revalidated.
Actual figure readability remains a separate closed-result check.
